  "scores": {
    "architecture": 8,
    "behavior": 8,
    "authority_security": 8,
    "validation": 8,
    "overall": 8
  },
  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 (medium) — apps/desktop/src/features/administration/runtime-changes.tsx:149-165: dictionary capture can silently change or discard input. chooseFile sets useFile before a successful selection; after cancellation or a failed selection, the file radio remains selected and typed keywords remain disabled, but draft() falls back to that typed field, including its template contents. Independently reproduced with the production component. The same constructor splices raw metadata into the enclosing JSON: invalid metadata such as a valid object followed by a top-level file fragment becomes a valid assembled body with duplicate file properties, and parsing discards the fragment. This was also independently reproduced. Validate metadata as one complete JSON object, refuse invalid raw input, and make an unavailable selected file an explicit error or restore an explicit source choice; do not silently substitute typed text. Acceptance: cancelled, failed and pending selections cannot review/apply an unselected source; malformed metadata fragments are refused; valid typed and file modes still capture their current inputs faithfully.",
    "R2 (medium) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/change_domain.rs:530-560,788-792 and crates/desktop-core/src/changes.rs:690-730: resolve_staged replaces fileRef with the full file text; preview_after then copies that text into ChangeReviewView.after, which is published in shell snapshots/updates. The C10 design and packet promise that selected-file content remains native and the renderer receives its token/name/size/line count. That promise holds only before Review: the existing canary assertion in dlp_subset checks the snapshot before preparing a review. Preserve native payload ownership in review projections, using a faithful file summary/digest instead of raw selected-file bytes. Acceptance: a staged canary is absent from snapshots and updates before and after Review and while confirming, while the reviewed digest and confirmed multipart upload remain bound to the exact staged bytes.",
    "R3 (medium) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/change_domain.rs:564-607 and settle_confirmation: ChooseDictionaryFile is admitted during Phase::Confirming and can replace or clear the staged payload without ending the pending confirmation. The callback checks context/expiry/nonce but has no staged-file binding to revalidate; it can still dispatch the previously prepared file after the native-owned file choice has changed. Disabling the React button does not enforce the native editor lease. Refuse file selection while that lease is held, or invalidate/end the confirmation when selection changes. Acceptance through the production authority interface: prepare file A, hold confirmation, attempt to choose file B or cancel selection, then complete the old confirmation; either the selection was refused and A remained held, or the old confirmation is retired and sends nothing. A newly reviewed B can subsequently apply once."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "E1 — C10 requires actual native file selection→review→apply and cancellation. C10-N03/N04 use the test-fixtures StagedText adapter (adapters.rs:92-121), which reads a driver-preselected file or returns None; it never opens NativeTextPicker's rfd/NSOpenPanel (475-500). Thus these records establish staging/upload behavior but not the production chooser's attachment, keyboard/focus, selection or cancellation path. Supply source/build-bound native evidence exercising the real chooser with synthetic files and cancellation, source preservation and the subsequent review/apply flow.",
    "E2 — The required per-operation success/deny/conflict/unknown matrix is incomplete. dlp_subset exercises successes across the nine supported DLP mutations, but its negative-outcome case covers denial and lost settlement only for dictionary create, and a changed baseline only for pattern replace. Native checks add the same examples rather than the remaining operation matrix. Add executed production-interface cases for each supported operation's denial and unknown outcome, plus applicable baseline conflicts/service conflicts, asserting truthful outcomes and no retry/replay. Include staged-file retirement and late picker completion so file references cannot survive tenant/credential context changes."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [
    "O1 — The mutation 'a pattern leaf may omit its confidence level' survives its selected changes-unit command (exit 0, guard_failed false). The integration suite already contains a missing-confidence rejection case. Point this probe at that causal guard, or add the intended unit negative case, so the retained probe demonstrates the claimed protection."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Independently recomputed all four supplied fingerprints twice: 366 source entries and 194 packet references matched, including command logs, before/after run inputs and native artifacts. Only this designated verdict was written; no application source was changed, product endpoints called or credentials accessed.",
    "Independently ran two in-memory React/JSDOM probes against the production ChangeWorkbench with simplified presentation controls and scripted dispatch. They reproduced the cancelled-file fallback and invalid-metadata-fragment behavior in R1. They did not exercise Tauri or perform uploads. R2 and R3 are source-path findings, not independently executed Rust/native reproductions.",
    "Retained checks report 254 frontend tests and 72 core unit tests passing. The scoped run reports 7 DLP integration, 14 Runtime-change integration and 44 controller tests passing, plus 84 overlapping frontend and 8 overlapping changes-unit tests. Four mutation baselines pass; 14 of 15 named mutation guards fail as intended. I inspected retained results rather than rerunning filesystem-writing build/test commands.",
    "Ten native acceptance records report 121 passing checks, including nine C10 checks, all bound to executable SHA-256 ed3f8bf3117fc0a26a104bf7672d65b5e2a13af0cc4ae0ebeb327413de94b37d. I inspected the records and driver source, not an independently operated native application. Real chooser coverage is absent as described in E1; spoken VoiceOver output remains unrecorded.",
    "Verified SDK archive SHA-256 6d555d955c3734dd5ee78f7173569bdecd4426095b2ffedc4b77d8f0f2c2e8d9 and all 131 packaged files against consumed registry source. Inspected the SDK dictionary multipart/204 contracts and retry/authentication engine, and compared the DLP capability matrix and data-profile validation with v1 source.",
    "Verified C09's receipt/request/verdict/raw-output hashes and completion ledger. Its 8/8/8/8/8 failed review was completed under owner acceptance D034, not an independent pass. C09 follow-up code and its new retained tests were inspected here, but this verdict does not replace the required C09 re-review before P03; its missing native retirement evidence remains explicitly recorded in follow-ups.md.",
    "No live DLP qualification, signing or installed-package verification is established. Those remain C25/C26 gates. Baseline re-read cannot prevent an external writer racing the final read where the service offers no conditional write."
  ],
